skill.summary: Compress and decompress text files using smart abbreviation and whitespace normalization. Use when user asks to compress, shrink, reduce, or optimize text fi...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of text-compressor.
- Compress and decompress text files with three configurable levels: basic cleanup, smart contractions, and aggressive abbreviation.
- Supports batch processing, file size reduction, and text cleanup.
- Outputs bytes saved and percentage size reduction.
- Decompression mode attempts to restore original content (approximate).
